425:t_3:95.en:
$$刹那$$
「Looks like trying to stop you is useless.」

425:t_3:96.en:
$n
「I may end up causing you trouble too. But...」

425:t_3:97.en:
$$甲児$$
「Cut it out. It's a little late for that.」

425:t_3:98.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Besides, Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't only your problem, $n.」

425:t_3:99.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's right. Don't worry about anything extra and give it everything you've got.」

425:t_3:102.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's not it. Miss $$スズネ$$ must have taught you what to say at a time like this.」

425:t_3:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, $n, who has sold your soul to the devil, allow me to tell you one more thing about the $$ジェニオン$$.」

425:t_3:105.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$'s machine category name, $$ＤＥＭ$$, stands for Dimension Energy Machinery, but besides that...」

425:t_3:106.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It also carries the meaning of Diabolus Ex Machina.」

425:t_3:107.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Diabolus Ex Machina... A devil made of machinery, then.」

425:t_3:108.en:
$$桂$$
「That's bad taste all the way down.」

425:t_3:109.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n... Use that power to turn everything upside down.」

425:t_3:110.en:
$n
「I will... I'll save Miss $$スズネ$$... and $$セツコ$$, no matter what.」

425:t_3:112.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Even if you can draw out the $$スフィア$$'s power, it seems you can't cheer openly in this situation.」

425:t_3:113.en:
$$青山$$
「You mean $$セツコ$$ and $$バルビエル$$?」

425:t_3:114.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course that bothers me too, but $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s existence just doesn't sit right with me...」

425:t_3:115.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You guys... you were fighting alongside him, weren't you? Why are you saying this now?」

425:t_3:116.en:
$$クルツ$$
「There are definitely suspicious things about him, but at least he's not our enemy.」

425:t_3:118.en:
$$ランド$$
「When we were fighting alongside him, we had the same conversation and ended up with the same conclusion.」

425:t_3:119.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Hey... Ever heard the saying 'love is blind'?」

425:t_3:120.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「What's this all of a sudden...?」

425:t_3:121.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe we rely too much on instinct and emotion, and we're losing our composure...」

425:t_3:122.en:
???
「...As expected of the $$揺れる天秤$$ Reactor. You really do see your own will through.」

425:t_3:124.en:
$$トライア$$
「We finally meet again, and that's how you greet me?」

425:t_3:125.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$トライア・スコート$$... Just arrived on the $$翠の地球$$.」

425:t_10:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Everyone, you've made up your minds, right?」

425:t_10:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We're getting Miss $$スズネ$$ back with our own hands, no matter what!」

425:t_10:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Look ahead, $$シンジ$$. $n has steeled himself too.」

425:t_10:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll back up $n and stop Miss $$スズネ$$.」

425:t_10:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nobody gave the order. This is our own will... In other words, volunteer work.」

425:t_10:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Fine by me, Volunteer Club. First activity in a long time that isn't picking up trash.」

425:t_10:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「Put some spirit into it, Club President.」

425:t_10:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「Volunteer Club president to all members. Our mission is to help $n and get Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」

425:t_10:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go! We're making this mission a success, no matter what!」

425:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(How admirable, all of you. It seems you resolved yourselves in the course of the fight with Miss $$スズネ$$.)

425:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That strong will has produced a $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add it to the unit's stock.)

425:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If I went out there now, I'd only be dampening everyone's morale, so I'll wish you the best of luck from here.)

425:t_10:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't push yourself too hard, $$シン$$.」

425:t_10:24.en:
$$シン$$
「...I know. But I'm definitely saving $$セツコ$$.」

425:t_10:25.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「...Hey... Do you like $$セツコ$$, $$シン$$?」

425:t_10:26.en:
$$シン$$
「...It's not about liking her or anything. I've just always been grateful to $$セツコ$$.」

425:t_10:28.en:
$$シン$$
「When I was running simulations to fight your $$フリーダム$$ with the $$インパルス$$, $$キラ$$, $$セツコ$$ told me something.」

425:t_10:29.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't fight out of hatred... she said.」

425:t_10:31.en:
$$シン$$
「In the end, I fought you out of hatred, $$キラ$$.」

425:t_10:32.en:
$$シン$$
「But even after that, $$セツコ$$'s words stayed deep in my ears.」

425:t_10:33.en:
$$シン$$
「I still think I was able to come back to $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ thanks to everyone and to those words of $$セツコ$$'s.」

425:t_10:36.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Got it, $$シン$$. Sorry for asking something weird.」

425:t_10:37.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm the one who's sorry... For making you worry for no reason, $$ルナ$$.」

425:t_10:38.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「It's fine. ...Let's do our best, $$シン$$.」

425:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$多元戦争$$ greatly changed $$シン$$'s destiny.)

425:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That was due to his own strength and that of the people around him, but it seems $$セツコ$$ was involved in it too.)

425:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$シン$$, everyone... I too pray for $$セツコ$$'s safety.)

425:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I don't feel up to appearing before everyone right now, so the congratulations to our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but...)

425:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is operating as usual.)

425:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well then, for today, I'll keep a low profile... Business is business.)

426:t_000:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Confirmed self-destruction of the base facilities!」

426:t_000:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「At the same time, we confirmed that the remaining $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers are pulling back too!」

426:t_001:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$ターミナル・ベース$$ assault was a success, but a self-destruct is strange.」

426:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well now, that's rare these days. It used to be a common sight for concealing information, though.」

426:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Maybe there was something here worth that much.」

426:t_001:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return. We'll send in ground personnel and investigate the inside of the facility.」

426:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The resistance was fiercer than I expected. It seems forces really are gathering from all over.」
